name: Sea The
overview: Scripture reveals that God created the seas as a distinct part of His orderly creation, separating the dry land from the gathered waters and filling them with abundant living creatures, including great whales and winged fowl, all of which He saw as good (Genesis 1:10, 20-22). The seas are also depicted as vast and significant, symbolized by the sand upon the seashore, which is used to illustrate the innumerable descendants promised to Abraham, highlighting God's blessing and sovereign provision (Genesis 22:17). Additionally, the seas serve as geographical and historical markers, such as the salt sea mentioned in the vale of Siddim, emphasizing their role in God's unfolding plan.
